meta.name: baoyu-post-to-x
meta.description: Posts content and articles to X (Twitter). Supports regular posts with images/videos and X Articles (long-form Markdown). Uses real Chrome with CDP to bypass anti-automation. Use when user asks to "post to X", "tweet", "publish to Twitter", or "share on X".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动将内容发布到 X 平台
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要定时或批量发布推文和长文到 X。
copy.tagline_en: Automatically post content to X platform
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to schedule or batch post tweets and articles to X.

howto.what: Claude 能把文字、图片、视频和 Markdown 长文章发布到 X（推特）。它用真实 Chrome 浏览器操作，绕过反自动化限制。
howto.when: 当你说“发推”“发布到 X”“分享到 X”等要求时触发。

say.text: 帮我发一条推，内容：今天天气真好。
say.note: Claude 会生成预览并请求确认。

say.text: 把这张图片和文字发到 X。
发布这份 Markdown 稿件到 X。
say.note: Claude 会生成长文章预览。

howto.what_en: Claude can post text, images, videos, and long-form Markdown articles to X (Twitter). It uses a real Chrome browser to bypass anti-automation detection.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to "post to X", "tweet", "publish to Twitter", or similar.

say_en.text: Post a tweet for me: the weather is nice today.
say_en.note: Claude will preview and ask for confirmation.

say_en.text: Send this image and text to X.
say_en.note: Claude will prepare a post with image.

say_en.text: Publish this Markdown document to X.
say_en.note: Claude will generate a long-form article preview.
